note: Canonical tool registry. toolcheck workflow verifies + version-pins these against real upstream. status: verified|stale|broken|untested.

static.name: slither
static.install: pipx install slither-analyzer || pip install slither-analyzer
static.purpose: Static analysis framework for Solidity; 90+ detectors.

static.name: aderyn
static.purpose: Rust-based Solidity AST analyzer; fast, modern detectors.

static.name: mythril
static.purpose: Symbolic execution / EVM bytecode security analysis.

fuzzing.name: echidna
fuzzing.install: mkdir -p $HOME/.local/bin; TAG=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/crytic/echidna/releases/latest|grep tag_name|cut -d'"' -f4); VER=${TAG#v}; curl -fsSL https://github.com/crytic/echidna/releases/download/${TAG}/echidna-${VER}-x86_64-linux.tar.gz | tar xz -C $HOME/.local/bin

fuzzing.name: foundry
fuzzing.install: mkdir -p $HOME/.local/bin; TAG=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/foundry-rs/foundry/releases/latest|grep tag_name|cut -d'"' -f4); curl -fsSL https://github.com/foundry-rs/foundry/releases/download/${TAG}/foundry_${TAG}_linux_amd64.tar.gz | tar xz -C $HOME/.local/bin
fuzzing.purpose: Forge fuzz + invariant testing, Anvil mainnet-fork PoC.
